title: Characterization of flavor metabolites of cocultured fermented high acidity fruit wines, and the correlation between organic acids and esters
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6931-6942
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04203H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jian Liu, Can Lyu, Yongli Yang, Shijun Lu, Yuru Wen, Mengxue Sun, Zhaohuan Du, Wei Lin, Chensheng Xu, Zhao Chen, Lanmei Zhao, Ping Dong
Coculture fermentation of Saccharomyces yeast ScBV818 and Torulaspora delbrueckii significantly enhanced flavor intensity in high-acidity greengage wines by increasing acetate and ethyl esters, while enhancing fruity and floral aroma profiles.
